definitions.gloss: the other side; opposite side; far side
definitions.explanation: the side that is across from where one is standing or looking

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{向|む}こう{側|がわ}に{家|いえ}がある。
examples.english: There's a house on the other side of the river.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{向|む}こう{側|がわ}に{渡|わた}ってください。
examples.english: Please cross to the other side of the road.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}の{向|む}こう{側|がわ}から{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard a voice from the other side of the wall.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{向|む}こう (over there, the other side) + {側|がわ} (side)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {向|む}こう - over there (general direction)
- {向|む}こう{側|がわ} - the other side (specific side)
- {反対側|はんたいがわ} - opposite side
- {裏側|うらがわ} - back side, reverse side

COMMON PATTERNS:
~{側|がわ} (side) compounds:
- こちら{側|がわ} - this side
- あちら{側|がわ} - that side
- {右側|みぎがわ} - right side
- {左側|ひだりがわ} - left side
- {外側|そとがわ} - outside
- {内側|うちがわ} - inside
